chapterInfo.content:
1
AWURADE atemmuo da no
1 # Yer 1.2 AWURADE asɛm a ɛbaa Sefania a ɔyɛ Kusi ba Gedalia ba Amaria ba Hesekia ba nkyɛn, Yudahene Yosia a ɔyɛ Amon ba berɛ soɔ nie.
2Pra na mɛpra ade nyinaa
afiri asase ani akorɔ, AWURADE asɛm nie.
3 # Mat 13.41 Mɛpra onipa ne aboa akɔ,
mɛpra ewiem nnomaa
ne ɛpo mu mpataa akɔ,
ne suntidua ɛne abɔnefoɔ,
na matwitwa nnipa
afiri asase ani agu, AWURADE asɛm nie.
4 # 2 Ah 23.5; Hos 10.5 Na mɛtene me nsa, Yuda so
ne Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa so,
na mɛtwa Baal nkaeɛ
ne abosomfoɔ asɔfoɔ ne AWURADE asɔfoɔ a wɔapo no no din afiri ha yi agu,
5 # Yer 19.13; 49.1 ne wɔn a wɔsɔre ewiem nnoɔma
wɔ adan atifi,
ne asɔrefoɔ a wɔkeka AWURADE ntam
na wɔkeka Milkom ntam
6ne wɔn a wɔsane firi AWURADE akyi
ne wɔn a wɔnhwehwɛɛ AWURADE na wɔmmisaa n’akyiri kwan no.
7 # Hab 2.20 Monyɛ komm AWURADE Nyankopɔn anim,
na AWURADE da no abɛn,
na AWURADE asiesie okum afɔdeɛ,
wadwira wɔn a wafrɛ wɔn no.
8Na AWURADE kum afɔdeɛ da no,
mɛtwe mmapɔmma ne ahenemma no
ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ ananafoɔ ntadeɛ nyinaa aso.
9Na ɛda no, mɛtwe obiara a ɔhuri tra aponnwa aso,
wɔn a wɔde ɔhyɛ ne nsisie hyehyɛ
wɔn wuranom afie amaama.
10Na ɛda no, AWURADE asɛm nie,
esu nne bɛfiri Mpataa Pono no ano,
na adwotwa afiri Ɔfa a ɛtɔ so Mmienu no mu,
na ɔsɛeɛ kɛseɛ afiri nkokoɔ no so aba.
11Montwa adwo, mo a mote Mortar no,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔasɛe adwadifoɔ asafo no nyinaa,
na wɔatwitwa wɔn a wɔasoa dwetɛ nyinaa.
12Na ɛberɛ no mu mede nkanea bɛhwehwɛ Yerusalem mu,
na matwe nnipa a
wɔagya wɔn ho ama bɔne no aso,
wɔn a wɔse no wɔn akoma mu sɛ:
AWURADE renyɛ
ho hwee.
13 # Amos 5.11; Deut 28.39 Na wɔn ahonyadeɛ bɛdane fomfa adeɛ,
na wɔn afie adeda mpan.
Wɔbɛsisi adan,
na wɔrentena mu,
na wɔbɛyɛ bobe nturo,
na wɔrennom mu nsa.
14 # Yoel 1.15 AWURADE da kɛseɛ no abɛn,
abɛn na ɛrepɛ ntɛm sɛ;
AWURADE da no nne yɛ nwono sɛ!
ɔdɔmmarima team denden wɔ hɔ.
15 # Yer 13.7 Ɛda no yɛ anibereɛ da,
ahohiahia ne ahokyere da,
ɔsɛeɛ ne amamfoyɛ da,
esum ne kusuuyɛ da,
mununkum ne kusukuukuu da,
16totorobɛnto ne osebɔ da a ɛreba
afasuo mu nkuro
ne aban atentene ano sorɔnsorɔn soɔ.
17Na mɛhiahia nnipa ho
na wɔanante sɛ anifirafoɔ,
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE na wɔayɛ no bɔne;
na wɔn mogya bɛgu sɛ mfuturo,
na mato wɔn honam agu sɛ sɛbeɛ.
18Wɔn sika ne wɔn dwetɛ nso
rentumi nnye wɔn
AWURADE abufuo da no,
na ne ninkuntwe gya no
mu na asase no nyinaa bɛhyeɛ,
na ɔdwerɛ a ɛba mpofirim ara
na ɔde bɛba asase sofoɔ nyinaa soɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
